name: 左側大卡片＋右側四格小卡片拼貼
desc: 一大搭配數小的卡片拼貼：左側一張放插圖、大標題與橫跨按鈕的大卡片，右側四張置中排版的小卡片排成兩列兩欄，整組外框對齊；手機上大卡片在上，小卡片改成橫向一列。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。內容對齊頁面內容寬度，由一張大卡片和多張小卡片拼貼而成：左側大卡片約佔六成寬，右側約四成是小卡片排成的網格，每列兩張，小卡片等寬等高；右側網格的總高度和大卡片相同，整組上下緣對齊成整齊的矩形外框。大卡片內的元素靠左對齊：最上方是一張寬幅圖片，圖片右下角可疊一張方形小圖，放在圖片前面、蓋住圖片一部分，小圖下方可放小標籤，沒有時省略；圖片下方是大標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放說明文字，沒有時省略；接著是一顆按鈕，按鈕橫跨大卡片的內容寬度，按鈕文字下方可放次要文字，右端放小圖示；最下方可放一段小字的次要文字，沒有時省略。每張小卡片的內容水平置中、集中在卡片上半部：小圖示與小標籤並排，下方是標題，可放說明文字，沒有時省略；卡片右下角放一個小型圖示按鈕，卡片下半留白。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊：大卡片在上，小卡片在下。大卡片內的順序不變，原本在方形小圖下方的小標籤移到大標題下方靠左；方形小圖仍疊在寬幅圖片右下角前面，按鈕仍橫跨卡片寬。小卡片改成排成一列橫向排列：每張約佔畫面寬六成，第一張靠左對齊頁面內容寬度，右側露出下一張的一部分並被畫面右緣裁切，可左右滑動查看；小卡片內的組成不變。

en.name: Large feature card + four-up small card collage
en.desc: A one-large-plus-several-small card collage: on the left a large card with an image, headline and a spanning button; on the right four small centered cards in two rows of two, with the whole group sharing one outer frame. On mobile the large card sits on top and the small cards become a single horizontal row.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The content is aligned to the page content width and is a collage of one large card and multiple small cards: the large card on the left takes about sixty percent of the width, and the right forty percent is a grid of small cards, two per row, all equal in width and height; the total height of the right grid matches the large card, so the top and bottom edges of the whole group line up into a neat rectangular frame. Inside the large card, elements are aligned left: at the top is a wide image; optionally a square small image overlaps the bottom-right corner of the image, in front of it and covering part of it, with an optional label below the small image; omit them when there is no content. Below the image is a headline (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a description below; omit them when there is no content. Next is a button spanning the content width of the large card, with optional secondary text below the button text and a small icon at its right end. At the very bottom, optionally place a short passage of small secondary text; omit it when there is no content. In each small card, the content is horizontally centered and gathered in the upper half: a small icon and a label side by side, a title below, and optionally a description; omit it when there is no content. Place a small icon button in the bottom-right corner of each small card, leaving the lower half of the card open.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: The layout stacks vertically: the large card on top, the small cards below. The order inside the large card stays the same, except the label that sat below the square small image moves below the headline, aligned left; the square small image still overlaps the bottom-right corner of the wide image in front of it, and the button still spans the card width. The small cards become a single horizontal row: each takes about sixty percent of the screen width, the first one aligned left with the page content width, and part of the next one shows on the right, cropped by the right edge of the screen; the row can be swiped left and right. The composition of each small card stays the same.
